faqs.a: Yes. Build one job, watch its first runs, and decide from what it actually did.

faqs.q: Where do I start if I do not know what to hand off?
faqs.a: Ask Captain "Read my website and tell me what you would take off my plate". It answers straight away, without building anything, and you pick the first job from its list.

faqs.q: How long does it take to set up?
faqs.a: Minutes per job: you write a sentence, answer Captain’s questions, check the plan and tap Build it.

faqs.q: What if I want to change something later?
faqs.a: Tell the AI agent or app in its chat. Each change is a version you can undo.

faqs.q: What does it not do yet?
faqs.a: It does not send email as you without your approval, and it has no email address of its own. It does not make calls, book travel or pay for anything. Notifications come inside the app (Needs you, Home), not by SMS or WhatsApp.
